name: io.github.torutesu/shogunagent
title: ShogunAgent
description: The state layer for AI agents: people, projects, commitments and open loops, with provenance.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Bearer sa_live_… from POST /v1/agents; without it discover, inspect and narrow reads work.

packageArguments.description: Serve the local sidecar's memory over stdio, read-only (the subcommand `npx shogunagent mcp`).

environmentVariables.name: SHOGUNAGENT_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Where the local store, token and installed binaries live (default: the OS data directory).
